data.other_hard: doctorate at a German university; doctoral topic not yet begun (project counts as started if scientific work on the topic has lasted more than 1 year since graduation); thesis deals with the environmental situation in Germany or global environmental challenges with relevance for Germany; coherent resume; good knowledge of German; complete application documents written in German; no more than one application per working group/scientific supervisor per round; stays abroad only if doctoral studies take place mainly at the supervising institution in Germany
data.evidence_sentence: Your doctorate will be at a German university and has not yet begun.
data.notes: No application deadline date, nationality rule, or funding amount is stated on the page; the page refers to a funding guidelines PDF (dated Stand 2023) for detailed information. Min GPA is a verbal requirement ('above-average degree'). Incomplete or late applications cannot be considered; rejection precludes reapplication. Fellowships support individuals, not institutions. Goal of completing the doctorate within three years is a goal, not a requirement.
